source_followup.dem.1976.0.6: Version B defines m as the normalized unweighted binomial sum, so m=1; the subsequent quadratic objective is minimized at the weighted mean, which is 3/2 for n=3. Check whether a factor k is missing in the definition of m.
source_followup.dem.1998.1.3: The stored problem asks for nonnegative numbers without explicitly requiring integers. Verify whether the intended domain is nonnegative integers; classification follows the stored wording.
source_followup.dem.2000.2.6: The sequence is initially called positive integers, but a_(2^m)=1/m contradicts this for m>1. The final sentence instead calls it a sequence of positive reals. Check the official domain.
source_followup.hkt.2014.1.6: As stored, every positive m admits a positive n giving floor value 2013: choose n=ceil(2013*m*(3m+1)/(2m+1)); the admissible n-interval has length greater than one. Thus the requested sum over all qualifying m is not finite. Check missing bounds or quantifiers.
source_followup.rot.2025.3.9: Part (a) requests n-1 pair-merging steps while maintaining an adequate collection at every stage. A final one-element collection has no pair. Check whether the final stage is excluded or the number of steps was transcribed incorrectly.
